inventory: All observed contiguous EVA character prefixes/suffixes including full-length; internal sequences with at least one flanking character each side; whole words. Noncontiguous subsets excluded because not positional word parts.
screen: Unchanged v49 eligibility >=20 pooled occurrences and >=5 numbered folios; shared H/F loci; exact hand/Currier/format/first-interior-last; equal folio weights; 1999 maxT permutations plus panel Bonferroni; >=2pp and p<=.05 both readings
limitations: No grammar inference; rare strings inventoried but untested. Historical role comparison not qualified; no independent role annotations.
family: Four preselected contrasts, interiors only; remove focal prefix/suffix or first internal occurrence with both flanks retained. Three section-stratified SHA256 folio folds; top5 removal selected on training only; report every fold. Retrospective, not untouched confirmation.
